test_msssim_metric: test the MultiscaleStructuralSimilarity metric by updating with random image pairs and computing the result
run_msssim_test: run the pytest test_msssim function to validate MultiscaleStructuralSimilarity with parametric sample counts
create_msssim_metric: create a MultiscaleStructuralSimilarity instance and call update with two normalized tensor images
compute_msssim: compute the final multiscale structural similarity score after updating with sample pairs
review_test_msssim: review the test_msssim function that validates MultiscaleStructuralSimilarity using random normalized 4D image tensors
